gauge.name: Tuckasegee River at Barkers creek nr Dillsboro

impacts.statement: BARKERS CREEK ROAD WILL BEGIN TO FLOOD.
HOMES NEAR THE RIVER AND ALONG BARKERS CREEK WILL BEGIN TO FLOOD.
CREST OF 7.39 HERE AND 8.8 AT BIRN7 CAUSED A CREST DOWNSTREAM OF OVER 10 FT WILL OCCURR AT TKSN7
A CREST OF 6.37 HERE AND A CREST OF 7.71 AT BIRN7 CAUSED THE TKSN7 TO RISE TO 9.11 FT.
1 INCH RAIN IN 6 HOUR WILL TAKE RIVER TO 5.5 FT
